short: A model-driven system that can choose actions, call tools, observe results and continue until a task is complete.
A callable function or service that performs an action the language model cannot execute by itself.
Structured temporary data attached to a working session.
The full conversation context, events and state for one interaction history.
Information that can be retrieved across sessions or from a persistent knowledge store.
A predictable schema such as JSON that the interface can validate and render.
A handoff in which another agent becomes the active owner of the next step.
A specialist agent called as a bounded capability while the root agent keeps control.
A workflow in which later stages wait for earlier stages to finish.
A workflow that runs independent branches without requiring one branch to wait for another.
A bounded workflow that repeats until a condition or maximum iteration count is reached.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation: retrieve relevant content before the model writes an answer.
A numeric representation used to compare semantic similarity.
A store optimized for similarity search over embeddings.
A protocol for connecting an agent to tools and data sources through a consistent interface.
A protocol for communication between independent agent systems.
A machine-readable capability and endpoint profile for an A2A agent.
A durable output created by an agent, such as a report, file or structured object.
A restricted environment that limits what generated code can access.
A rule or code boundary that blocks unsafe or unwanted behavior.
